name: Ikkrukk
description: Ikkrukk was a mountainous planet in the Mid Rim. During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, the planet was attacked by the First Order. Black Squadron of the Resistance managed to defeat the First Order forces, saving Ikkrukk.
